title: User
$comment: v1.0. Accounts and sign-in (Phase 3, #94; docs/research/phase-3-decisions-alignment.md). Accounts are seeded (`just seed-users`), there is no public sign-up in the MVP. The session itself is an HTTP-only cookie, never in a response body.
